from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,pdfplumber
b=Path('reports/research/510300_fund_quarterly_aggregate_exposure_joint_cases_v1')
p=json.loads((b/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert not (b/'原三报告组合相关页与原表.json').exists()
records=[]
for source in p['fixed_local_original_sources']:
 path=Path(source['actual_original_pdf_path'])
 assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==source['expected_pdf_sha256']
 record={'case':source['case'],'original_pdf':source['actual_original_pdf_path'],'source_sha256':source['expected_pdf_sha256'],'pages':[]}
 with pdfplumber.open(path) as doc:
  for i,page in enumerate(doc.pages):
   t=page.extract_text() or ''
   if i==0 or '5.1 报告期末基金资产组合情况' in t or '5.2 报告期末按行业分类' in t or '5.2.1 报告期末指数投资' in t or '5.2.2 报告期末积极投资' in t:
    record['pages'].append({'PDF_page_number':i+1,'raw_page_text':t,'raw_tables':page.extract_tables()})
    if i>0:
     page.to_image(resolution=120).save(b/f"{source['case']['fixed_original_quarter']}_原组合第{i+1}页.png")
 record['page_count']=len(doc.pages)
 records.append(record)
(b/'原三报告组合相关页与原表.json').write_text(json.dumps({'extracted_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'records':records,'new_stock_labels_read':0},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for r in records:
 print(json.dumps({'quarter':r['case']['fixed_original_quarter'],'relevant_pages':[{'page':x['PDF_page_number'],'raw_text':x['raw_page_text']} for x in r['pages'] if x['PDF_page_number']>1]},ensure_ascii=False))
